mapper.select: SELECT owner_id,task_id,source_item_id AS item_id,source_version_id AS version_id, source_version_number AS number,source_title AS title,source_kind AS kind,ordinal FROM ai_preparation_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT owner_id,task_id,status,target_item_id,target_version_id,requirements_json,created_at FROM ai_jd_requirement_decision WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId}

SELECT requirements.requirement_id FROM preparation_version v JOIN JSON_TABLE(v.content_json,'$.requirements[*]' COLUMNS (position_index FOR ORDINALITY,requirement_id CHAR(36) PATH '$.id' ERROR ON EMPTY ERROR ON ERROR)) requirements WHERE v.owner_id=#{owner} AND v.item_id=#{itemId} AND v.id=#{versionId} ORDER BY requirements.position_index
